test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My friend, who is a photographer, is ________ a writer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**also**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word also is an **adverb**
 
• The word **also **mean in **addition, including , or further adding.**

*Example *: She is a good wife and **also **a fine actress.
